questions.question: In a 1,000 m race A beats B by 100 m. The ratio of their speeds A : B is
questions.explanation: A runs 1000 m while B runs 900 m: 10 : 9.

questions.question: In a 1,000 m race A beats B by 100 m. If A runs at 10 m/s, B runs at (m/s)
questions.explanation: B runs at 9/10 of A's speed: 9.

questions.question: In a 200 m race A beats B by 20 m. B runs at 4 m/s. A wins by (seconds)
A can run 200 m while B runs 180 m. In a 200 m race, the start A must give B for a dead heat is (metres)
In a 100 m race A beats B by 10 m. When A has run 50 m, B has run (metres)
A runs 100 m in 10 s and B in 12.5 s. A beats B in a 100 m race by (metres)
questions.explanation: B runs 8 m/s. In 10 s, B covers 80 m: 20 m behind.

questions.question: In a 100 m race A beats B by 10 m and B beats C by 10 m. A beats C by (metres)
questions.explanation: When A runs 100, B runs 90 and C runs 81. A beats C by 19.

questions.question: In a 200 m race A beats B by 20 m and B beats C by 20 m. A beats C by (metres)
questions.explanation: When A runs 200 m, B runs 180 and C runs 162. A beats C by 38.

questions.question: A can give B a start of 20 m in a 100 m race and C a start of 40 m. The start B can give C in a 100 m race is (metres)
A runs twice as fast as B. In a 400 m race, A gives B a start of (metres) so that the race ends in a dead heat
questions.explanation: B must cover half of A's distance: 200 m, so a start of 200 m.

questions.question: A and B run on a 400 m track at 8 m/s and 6 m/s in the same direction. A laps B for the first time after (seconds)
questions.explanation: Relative speed 2 m/s over a 400 m lap: 200 s.

questions.question: A runs 4/3 as fast as B. In a 600 m race, A beats B by (metres)
questions.explanation: B runs 3/4 of A's distance: 450 m. A wins by 150 m.

questions.question: A beats B by 5 seconds in a 100 m race. If B runs at 5 m/s, A's time is (seconds)
questions.explanation: B takes 20 s. A takes 15 s.

questions.question: A can run 1 km in 3 minutes and B in 3 minutes 20 seconds. A beats B by (metres) in a 1 km race
questions.explanation: A takes 180 s. B runs at 1000/200 = 5 m/s and covers 900 m in 180 s, so A wins by 100 m.

questions.question: A beats B by 20 m in a 100 m race and B beats C by 10 m in a 100 m race. A beats C by (metres) in a 100 m race
questions.explanation: When A runs 100, B runs 80. B runs 80 so C runs 80 × 0.9 = 72. A beats C by 28.

questions.question: In a km race, A beats B by 100 m, and B beats C by 100 m. In a 1 km race, A beats C by (metres)
questions.explanation: A : C = 1000 : 810. A beats C by 190 m.

questions.question: A can give B a start of 10 m in a 100 m race. In a race of 200 m, the start A can give B is (metres)
questions.explanation: The speed ratio A : B = 100 : 90. In 200 m, B covers 180 m, so the start is 20 m.

questions.question: Two runners on a 500 m track have speeds 5 m/s and 3 m/s and run in the same direction. The faster laps the slower for the first time after (seconds)
A beats B by 4 seconds in a 400 m race and B's speed is 8 m/s. A's time over the 400 m is (seconds)
questions.explanation: B takes 50 s. A takes 46 s.

questions.question: A is 25% faster than B. In a 500 m race A gives B a start of (metres) for a dead heat
questions.explanation: A : B = 5 : 4. B covers 400 m, so the start is 100 m.
